title: Hannah
summary: Raleigh names Hannah in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hannah, the mother of Samuel, who obtained him of God by prayers and teares, called also Hanna, and not Anna the mother of Mary nor Anna the sister of Dido. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
